layout_sources: https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/develop/bank2ynab/data/bank2ynab.conf [DK Danske Bank] (file name "<Accountname>-<10 digits>-<8 digits>.csv"; header comment "Dato";"Kategori";"Underkategori";"Tekst";"Bel�b";"Saldo";"Status";"Afstemt" - the replacement character shows the file is not UTF-8; semicolon; %d.%m.%Y; amount and running balance columns)
notes: Danske eBanking "Eksporter" CSV. Every field double-quoted, semicolon-separated, Windows-1252 (the ø of Beløb is one byte), CRLF. Dates DD.MM.YYYY; amounts in Danish form with a dot for thousands and a comma decimal ("-7.950,00"); Saldo is the balance after each line; Status "Udført", Afstemt "Nej". The currency is not named anywhere in the file (DKK). Oldest first is assumed (not confirmed). Closing = the last line's Saldo; opening = the first line's Saldo minus its amount.
